answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to post a refundable stake that vests slowly, like an ember that must be tended before it warms anything: clones cannot fake history, so a single identity grows reputation the way a vine climbs one trellis, while cheap copies stay bare. The stake also acts as a bridge between work and trust — honest attestations release it, fraud burns it, so spinning up a thousand fake agents costs a thousand stakes and pays nothing back.
